Test of "undeclared" diagnostic in generated code (Go 1.22+).

In Go 1.22, the error message format changed.

-- flags --
-min_go=go1.22

-- go.mod --
module example.com
go 1.12

-- generated.go --
package generated

// Code generated by generator.go. DO NOT EDIT.

func _() {
	var y int //@diag("y", re"(declared and not used: y|y declared and not used)")
}

-- generator.go --
package generated

func _() {
	var x int //@diag("x", re"(declared and not used: x|x declared and not used)")
}
